OFFICIAL RULES — THE HARROWGATE COFFEE 2026 SPRING GIVEAWAY

NO PURCHASE NECESSARY TO ENTER OR WIN. A PURCHASE DOES NOT INCREASE YOUR CHANCES OF WINNING. VOID WHERE PROHIBITED.

1. Sponsor. Harrowgate Coffee Roasters, Inc., 118 Kestrel Lane, Portland, Oregon 97209.

2. Eligibility. Open to legal residents of the fifty United States and the District of Columbia who are 18 years of age or older as of the date of entry. Employees of Sponsor, its affiliates, and their immediate family members and household members are not eligible. Void in Puerto Rico and where prohibited by law.

3. Entry Period. The Giveaway begins at 12:00:00 a.m. Pacific Time on April 1, 2026 and ends at 11:59:59 p.m. Pacific Time on April 30, 2026 (the "Entry Period"). Sponsor's computer is the official timekeeper.

4. How to Enter. Purchase entry: buy any bag of coffee at harrowgate.example during the Entry Period to receive one entry. Free alternate method of entry: mail a 3x5 card with your name, address, telephone number, and email address to Harrowgate Spring Giveaway AMOE, P.O. Box 4417, Portland, Oregon 97208. Mail-in entries must be postmarked by April 30, 2026 and received by May 7, 2026. Limit one entry per person per day by either method. Entries received by the free method have an equal chance of winning as entries received by purchase.

5. Prize. One (1) grand prize: a Harrowgate espresso machine and a twelve-month coffee subscription, with an approximate retail value of $3,400. Total approximate retail value of all prizes: $3,400. Odds of winning depend on the number of eligible entries received. The prize is not transferable and no substitution is permitted except by Sponsor, who may substitute a prize of equal or greater value.

6. Winner Selection and Notification. The winner will be selected in a random drawing on or about May 12, 2026 from all eligible entries received. The winner will be notified by email and telephone within three (3) business days of the drawing and must respond within five (5) business days or the prize will be forfeited and an alternate winner selected.

7. Taxes. All federal, state, and local taxes on the prize are the sole responsibility of the winner. Sponsor will issue an IRS Form 1099 to the winner.

8. Publicity. Except where prohibited, acceptance of the prize constitutes consent to Sponsor's use of the winner's name, city, state, and likeness for promotional purposes without further compensation.

9. General Conditions. By entering, entrants agree to these Official Rules and to the decisions of Sponsor, which are final and binding. Sponsor is not responsible for lost, late, misdirected, or illegible entries.

10. Governing Law and Disputes. These Official Rules are governed by the laws of the State of Oregon. Any dispute shall be resolved individually in the state or federal courts located in Multnomah County, Oregon, and entrants waive any right to class-wide relief.

11. Winner List. For the name of the winner, send a stamped self-addressed envelope to Harrowgate Spring Giveaway Winner List at the address in Section 4 by June 30, 2026.
